title: M5Stack AtomS3R-M12 Volcengine Kit · D062-M12
summary: AtomS3R-M12 与音频底座组成的视觉语音套件，采用 OV3660 摄像头、ESP32-S3-PICO-1-N8R8 和 I2S 音频。
limitations: Manufacturer exterior CAD only; board/display/peripheral runtime unavailable.
No physical hardware measurements; colors are photograph-informed approximations, not calibrated materials.
PCB has no audited complete board layout and is represented only by a visible neutral UNKNOWN placeholder.
Catalog dimensions refer to controller26.4×24×22.5mm; audio base separately24×24×14.1mm. Full kit/battery cable envelope is not inferred by adding overlapping parts.
Official camera specification says OV3660, while pinmap heading says OV3360; conflict retained as unknown, no chip substitution inferred.
Battery lead/external cell shown in kit photographs is not modeled as a connected electrical battery. Front photo includes cable so comparison is qualitative.
Camera optical glass is a photo-informed flat approximation; no optical/ray-tracing/camera pipeline.
Paper/optical projection is isolated from molded shell; small printed markings and hidden hardware not supplied by source CAD may remain incomplete.
assemblyNotes: Original manufacturer components selected from assembled cluster; other components excluded with reasons. One rigid global transform, no scaling.
